ana: Heads up — nightly Mistral-8x7b perf job showed a 95p tail spike after the kernel-selector tweak. 95p went from ~120ms -> ~240ms on text-gen load. Repro: staging/k8s-run-8x7b, seed workload (sliding-window chat).
sam: ugh. which change exactly? the kernel selector commit from yesterday?
ana (typo) — ignore^^ ana: yes the selector change that prefers the new fused-attn path for batches > 512 tokens. I can paste the perf log.
perf-bot: nightly-run/2026-03-18 03:10 UTC — job: mistral-8x7b-staging — 95p_latency: 240ms (+100%) — link: https://ci.internal/runs/8321
mike: paste logs pls, we need kernel trace + kv cache hit/miss counts.
nana (again) — just kidding ana: here's the relevant snippet from runtime profile (NVTX spans collapsed):
```
[2026-03-18T03:09:12Z] request_id=abc123 kernel_selector: selected=fused_attn_v2 batch_tokens=640 seq_len=256
[2026-03-18T03:09:12Z] kv_cache: lookup_shard=3 hits=18 misses=42 miss_ratio=0.7
[2026-03-18T03:09:12Z] attention: sliding_window=true pos_offset=3840 max_pos=4096 rope_scale=0.98
[2026-03-18T03:09:12Z] perf: attn_ms=120 matmul_ms=30 kv_lookup_ms=70 other_ms=20 total_ms=240
```
sam: interesting — kv miss ratio 70% at those batches. sounds like cache churn. fused_attn_v2 might not be cache-friendly for tiled KV access pattern.
taylor: also note pos_offset=3840 — we're crossing the 4096 boundary frequently due to sliding window + max_pos mismatch for some chats. rope_scale 0.98 indicates we apply RoPE scaling near boundary which changes attention numeric behavior and might force fallback in some kernels.
mike: do we have a recent change where kernel_selector ignored 'prefetch_kv' flag? that would increase on-demand KV fetches instead of prefetching prefix tiles.
nana (again) — ana: there was a change that bumped the batch_token threshold from 512 -> 600 and removed a special-case for sliding-window sequences. I suspect the selector now picks fused_attn_v2 which assumes contiguous KV layout, but our sliding-window implementation shards KV in ring buffers causing scattered reads.
sam: repro attempt: run with env KERNEL_SELECTOR=old_threshold and PREFETCH_KV=1. can you run a quick A/B?
nana (again) — ana: ran both locally:
- old selector + prefetch: 95p = 118ms, kv_miss=12%
- new selector (fused_attn_v2) + no prefetch: 95p = 238ms, kv_miss=69%
So it's consistent.
mike: ok mitigation: revert threshold bump in selector, and re-enable sliding-window special-case so fused_attn_v2 isn't chosen when pos_offset > max_pos - 512. Also add a fast path that forces prefix_cache=true for chat workloads. Patch suggestion in one-liner: `if sliding_window and pos_offset > max_pos - 1024: prefer(kv-prefetchable-kernel)`
taylor: long-term we should make fused_attn_v2 aware of tiled/ring KV layout or flatten the ring reads into a contiguous staging buffer before calling the kernel. That would keep perf benefits without cache thrash.
sam: also check RoPE handling — rope_scale != 1 can trigger numeric path differences that make some kernels fallback to a reference implementation. The profile shows no explicit fallback but rope scaling near boundary could amplify small diffs and cause additional attention overhead (extra dtype casts).
nana (again) — ana: hmm we saw dtype casts in the trace earlier (`cast_fp16->fp32`) right before attention loop in a few requests. I think the fused kernel expects a stable scale factor; variable rope scaling per-request causes extra ops.
mike: short checklist:
1) revert selector threshold (hotfix) -> reduces tail now
2) re-enable sliding-window rule -> avoids fused kernel selection for ringKV
3) add unit test that runs sliding-window with pos_offset near max_pos and asserts kernel choice + kv_miss < 25%
4) perf test matrix: {batch_tokens:256,512,768} x {seq_len:128,256,512} on 8x7b image
I'll PR the revert + test.
nana (again) — ana: filed PR #4523 with revert and tests. link: https://git.internal/r/4523 — running canary now.
perf-bot: canary/2026-03-18 03:45 UTC — mistral-8x7b-canary — 95p_latency: 126ms (down from 240ms)
sam: nice. moving forward we still need to address root cause: fused_attn_v2 assumptions + sliding-window interactions + rope_scale boundary behavior. I'll own a spike to prototype an adapter that assembles contiguous KV tiles when we detect ring layout.
taylor: add a regression test for max_position_embeddings handling: some callers were sending requests with `position_ids` reset but leaving `pos_offset` non-zero; that mismatch forces the runtime to remap positions and triggers weird attention masks. Test should cover both explicit position_ids and implicit offset.
mike: Agree. Also add a perf monitor alert for kv_miss ratio > 40% for production routes — that'll catch regressions earlier.
nana (again) — ana: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring the canary and follow up with kernel/adapter design doc later this week. :thumbsup:
sam: ack. thanks for the quick revert and numbers. :eyes:
taylor: adding tasks to runtime backlog (RT ticket 789).
